title: The Prom of Maple Street
premise: Elodie Delacroix, a scholarship student counting down to graduation, discovers her late grandmother's recipe box holds spellwork — and one recipe, 'For the One You Cannot Keep,' binds her to a hidden covenant the academy was built to protect. The covenant demands a champion, chosen at prom, to renew the wards that keep a hungry old magic beneath Maple Street at bay. Elodie must win the school's meaningless baking championship to earn a place at prom, and then win the real contest — a duel of memory and devotion against the heir who was born for the role — while falling for Theo, the boy whose family has served the covenant for generations. She wins both, but only by rewriting the recipe itself, trading her grandmother's final secret for a covenant that asks for belonging instead of sacrifice, and choosing to stay in Maple Street not out of duty, but love.
about_author: J. M. Ashgrove grew up in a small river town where every street had a story and every kitchen had a locked drawer, and has been writing about both ever since. A former pastry line cook and high school debate coach, they write young adult fiction about ordinary towns with extraordinary debts.

chapters.title: Counting Days
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. A scholarship student at Bellamy Academy, Elodie endures a cafeteria hierarchy she can't afford to join and counts the 74 days until graduation. She wins a surprise entry into the school's Founders' Baking Championship — a joke to everyone but her grandmother, who taught her everything. Emotional beat: restless longing for escape.

chapters.title: The Recipe Box
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Sorting her grandmother's things, Elodie finds the recipe box: index cards in familiar handwriting for dishes she's never heard of — 'For Keeping the Dark Down,' 'For a Door That Shouldn't Open.' One card is warm to the touch. Emotional beat: grief sharpened into curiosity.

chapters.title: Cardamom and Ash
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV, with a brief Theo interlude. Following a card's instructions, Elodie bakes in the school's night kitchen; the oven flame turns silver and the room fills with the smell of her grandmother's house. Theo Marchetti, kitchen monitor, catches her — and doesn't report her. Emotional beat: first spark of connection.

chapters.title: The Rules of Bellamy
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie maps the academy's unwritten rules: which families sit where, which halls are off-limits, why the Marchettis are 'legacy' and she is 'the scholarship.' Her rival, Camille Ashford, warns her off the championship with terrifying politeness. Emotional beat: the sting of being an outsider by design.

chapters.title: What Theo Knows
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo recognizes the recipe card's script — his family keeps the matching half of the box. He's been raised on the covenant since birth: Bellamy Academy exists to guard the Hollow beneath Maple Street, renewed by a champion chosen at prom. He decides Elodie must be kept ignorant. Emotional beat: duty crushing honesty.

chapters.title: Preliminary Rounds
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie's first championship bake stuns the judges — too much so. Camille's entry is flawless and flavorless. That night, Elodie's card box hums when she passes the sealed east wing. Emotional beat: triumph shadowed by wrongness.

chapters.title: The Hollow Under the Street
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo walks the ward-line with his grandmother, who is fading and can no longer fully hold the Marchetti obligations. The Hollow stirs early this year. She tells him the prom champion must be chosen soon — and that it was never meant to be him. Emotional beat: inherited dread.

chapters.title: Study Partners
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Theo offers to help Elodie prepare for the semifinals — ostensibly. Their study sessions in the kitchen turn into something warmer: he teaches her old techniques, she makes him laugh for the first time in months. Emotional beat: cautious falling.

chapters.title: Camille's Inheritance
chapters.summary: Camille's POV. Camille has trained her whole life for the championship, because the Ashfords expect their daughter to be chosen champion at prom — the honor her family has bought with three generations of donations. She sees Elodie as a thief of her one purpose. Emotional beat: ambition as armor.

chapters.title: The Card That Burns
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie tries a second recipe — 'For Seeing What Waits' — and glimpses something vast and patient beneath the school's foundations. The card chars in her hands. She tells no one, but Theo notices the burn on her fingers. Emotional beat: fear she can't un-know.

chapters.title: Semifinals
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie and Camille advance to the final. That evening the east wing doors, locked for decades, stand ajar. Inside: a kitchen older than the school, with a recipe box identical to her grandmother's. Emotional beat: vertigo — her family belongs here more than she knew.

chapters.title: The Delacroix Debt
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo confronts Elodie in the old kitchen and tells her everything: the covenant, the Hollow, the champion. Her grandmother was the last champion — and never told her. Elodie's fury is volcanic. Emotional beat: betrayal, and the first honest thing between them.

chapters.title: Grandmother's Letters
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. In the recipe box's false bottom, Elodie finds letters: her grandmother didn't abandon the covenant — she fled it, hiding the box where only a granddaughter who baked from love would ever find it. The final letter is addressed to 'the girl who finishes my recipes.' Emotional beat: grief reframed as inheritance.

chapters.title: Seventeen Days to Prom
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie resolves not to run like her grandmother, but she refuses to be a sacrifice either. She'll enter the championship to reach prom — and prom to reach the choosing — on her own terms. Theo, torn, agrees to train her in covenant craft. Emotional beat: resolve kindled.

chapters.title: Wardcraft 101
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo teaches Elodie the old craft — salt lines, memory-binding, the grammar of recipes as spells. She learns faster than anyone he's seen, because she cooks with feeling instead of fear. Emotional beat: teacher and student becoming equals.

chapters.title: The Ashford Bargain
chapters.summary: Camille's POV. Camille's father offers Elodie a bribe to withdraw — and reveals the champion's prize isn't glory but service, and the champion's cost isn't paid in money. Camille, shaken, realizes she never asked what being chosen meant. Emotional beat: the first crack in her certainty.

chapters.title: The Hollow Rises
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Something under Maple Street answers Elodie's practice spell — by name. It knows her grandmother. It offers her a deal: walk away, and it will leave the town alone for one year. Elodie refuses, and the refusal costs her the warmth from every oven in the school. Emotional beat: the enemy becomes personal.

chapters.title: Cold Ovens
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. With the semifinal bake days away and every stove dead, Elodie must bake over open flame using the old ways Theo taught her. The whole school smells woodsmoke; rumors spread that she's cursed. Emotional beat: isolation deepening into defiance.

chapters.title: What Camille Saw
chapters.summary: Camille's POV. Camille follows Elodie to the old kitchen, intending sabotage, and instead witnesses the Hollow pressing against the wards — and sees Elodie hold the line alone with nothing but a whisk and a salt line. Emotional beat: rivalry curdling into reluctant respect.

chapters.title: The Marchetti Secret
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo's grandmother confesses the family's shame: the Marchettis have been feeding the Hollow small memories for years — first loves, best days — to keep it quiet between champions. Theo has already given it his mother's laugh. Emotional beat: the true cost of duty revealed.

chapters.title: Elodie's Offer
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie proposes the unthinkable: rewrite the covenant recipe. Not a champion chosen by blood or bribe, but a ward renewed by shared memory — the whole town feeding the Hollow small joys instead of one person feeding it everything. Theo says it can't work. She starts baking anyway. Emotional beat: love against duty, stated plainly.

chapters.title: Test Batch
chapters.summary: Elodie and Theo's alternating POV. The experimental recipe — 'For Many Hands, One Table' — requires memories freely given, folded into dough. They test it on themselves: Theo gets back a memory of his mother's laugh; Elodie feels her grandmother's kitchen around her, real as breath. Emotional beat: hope with proof.

chapters.title: The Finals Announced
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. The championship final is set for prom night itself — by design, the headmaster admits when Elodie corners him. He's a warden, not a villain, and he believes the old way is the only way. Elodie disagrees. Emotional beat: institution versus individual.

chapters.title: Camille's Choice
chapters.summary: Camille's POV. Camille confronts her father with what she learned and is ordered to win at any cost — including a sabotaging charm slipped into her kit. Alone with the charm, Camille makes her decision. Emotional beat: breaking from the family script.

chapters.title: The Sabotage
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. On the eve of finals, Elodie's station is wrecked and her grandmother's letters stolen. Evidence points to Camille. Theo believes it; Elodie doesn't. Their first real fight. Emotional beat: trust under pressure.

chapters.title: The Confession
chapters.summary: Camille's POV. Camille returns the letters, admits the charm was hers — planted, but never used — and offers the only thing she has: her family's copy of the original covenant recipe, which her father kept hidden even from her. Emotional beat: an alliance no one expected.

chapters.title: Reading the Original
chapters.summary: Elodie, Theo, and Camille's alternating POV. The original recipe is a horror: the Hollow was once a guardian, starved and twisted by a covenant that fed it fear and sacrifice. Elodie's grandmother's letters annotate the margins — she'd already begun rewriting it. Emotional beat: the enemy's tragic truth.

chapters.title: Prom Preparations
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Prom week: gowns, gymnasium paper stars, and a secret kitchen operation baking a hundred memory-buns with the rewritten recipe, each requiring a freely given memory from a student or teacher willing to help. More people say yes than Elodie dreamed. Emotional beat: belonging, earned at last.

chapters.title: The Headmaster's Warning
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. The headmaster catches the operation and gives them one night to stop — or he'll seal the kitchen. He shows Theo what happened the last time a recipe was changed: a town that forgot itself entirely. Theo wavers. Elodie doesn't. Emotional beat: the cost of being first.

chapters.title: The Night Before
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie and Theo on the roof of the east wing, the Hollow's pull faint beneath them like a second heartbeat. He gives her his mother's laugh — freely, permanently — for the final batch. She gives him her grandmother's lullaby. Emotional beat: love as a thing you hand over.

chapters.title: Prom
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Paper stars, a live band, and a championship final held under the gymnasium's chaperoned lights. Elodie and Camille bake side by side in the showcase — rivals, then something like friends. The floor begins to hum during Elodie's final presentation. Emotional beat: joy with the ground trembling under it.

chapters.title: The Championship
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Elodie wins the Founders' Championship — and the win is announced as the traditional opening of the Choosing. The gymnasium's lights die. The floor opens like a throat. The headmaster, grim, begins the old rite. Emotional beat: triumph and trap in the same breath.

chapters.title: The Choosing
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. The rite demands a champion by blood and fear. The Hollow reaches for Theo — born for it, owed by it. Camille steps forward too, claiming her inheritance. And Elodie walks to the center of the floor with a tray of warm buns and refuses the entire premise. Emotional beat: three kinds of courage.

chapters.title: The Duel of Memory
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. The covenant tests Elodie the old way: it strips her memories one by one, offering to return them if she renounces the rewrite. She loses her grandmother's face, her first day at Bellamy, Theo's name — and keeps baking, hands remembering what her mind forgets. Emotional beat: identity tested to the marrow.

chapters.title: One Table
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs, braided. The hundred memory-buns are passed hand to hand down the gymnasium — students, teachers, the headmaster himself — each person giving one small joy freely. The Hollow, fed belonging instead of fear, remembers what it was: a guardian. The wards blaze silver. Emotional beat: the climax as collective act.

chapters.title: What the Hollow Returned
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. The Hollow gives back what the duel took — and more: every memory the Marchettis ever fed it, including Theo's mother's laugh, returned to him whole. The guardian settles beneath Maple Street, quiet and fed. The old covenant burns to ash in Elodie's hands. Emotional beat: restitution and release.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. Graduation. The headmaster offers Elodie the wardenship; she declines — she's going to culinary school, and the wards belong to everyone now, tended in kitchens across town. Camille and Elodie exchange numbers, actually meaning it. Emotional beat: the future opening wide.

chapters.title: The Last Recipe
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV. In the emptied recipe box, one new card appears in her grandmother's handwriting: 'For the Girl Who Finished My Recipes — make it your own.' Elodie writes her first card in her own hand and files it beside her grandmother's. Emotional beat: grief resolved into legacy.

chapters.title: Prom, Again
chapters.summary: Elodie and Theo's alternating POV. A do-over dance in Theo's backyard — no rites, no Hollow, just string lights and a borrowed speaker. Theo tells her the truth he's carried since the night kitchen: he stayed ignorant on purpose, and he's sorry, and he's not sorry about her. She kisses him mid-sentence. Emotional beat: love chosen freely, at last.

chapters.title: Maple Street
chapters.summary: Elodie's POV, final chapter. Summer. Elodie teaches a free Saturday baking class in the old east-wing kitchen — wardcraft disguised as pastry, open to anyone. The Hollow hums contentment beneath the floor like a sleeping dog. She came to Bellamy counting days until she could leave; she stays because she finally belongs. Emotional beat: homecoming.
